A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''overseer''' of [[the Brothers]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] organization handled a trade deal with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and respective [[Manager of Involuntary Labor|contact]] within the [[Brothers Oversight Center]] in [[3627 BBY]]. During that time, the Brothers' base was assaulted by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned individual and the Brothers' overseer was eliminated along with the Imperial official.<ref name="Brotherhoood Emancipation" />
